title: Biosolids PFAS Mass-Balance Laundering, CERCLA Strict-Liability Transfer & FIFRA Section 136v(b) Preemption Schema
description: Validates the three executable verification vectors of SPEC-BIOSOLIDS-PFAS-MASS-BALANCE-LAUNDERING-AND-FIFRA-PREEMPTION-v1.0: (1) the Carbon-Fluorine mass-conservation identity M_in = M_eff + M_sludge across WWTP secondary treatment with f_eff + f_sludge = 1.0 and eta_destroy = 0.0%, (2) the 40 C.F.R. Part 503 disposal arbitrage and CERCLA 42 U.S.C. 9607(a)(1) strict-liability transfer closing at a +$17,914,000/yr utility net defection surplus with alpha = 0.92 landowner retention, and (3) the 30.0x atrazine MCL-to-biological-threshold regulatory gap under the FIFRA 7 U.S.C. 136v(b) failure-to-warn preemption shield.

Vector1CarbonFluorineMassConservation.description: EQ_01: Because the C-F covalent bond dissociation energy E_CF = 485.0 kJ/mol exceeds the metabolic/thermal energy budget of conventional secondary wastewater treatment (eta_destroy = 0.0%), incoming PFAS mass M_in is strictly conserved between liquid effluent (f_eff = 0.38) and dewatered sewage sludge (f_sludge = 0.62): M_in = M_eff + M_sludge with f_eff + f_sludge = 1.0. A reference 100.0 kg influent load closes exactly: 38.0 kg effluent + 62.0 kg sludge + 0.0 kg destroyed.

Vector2Part503DisposalArbitrageAndCERCLA.description: EQ_02: A municipal WWTP generating Q = 25,000 dry tons/yr saves (C_haz - C_503) * Q = ($850.0 - $120.0) * 25,000 = $18,250,000/yr by rebranding sludge as 'Class A/B Biosolids' for agricultural land application. Under CERCLA 42 U.S.C. 9607(a)(1) current-owner strict joint-and-several liability, activated for PFOA/PFOS by 40 C.F.R. Part 302 (89 Fed. Reg. 39124, May 8, 2024), alpha = 0.92 of the $4,200,000 per-farm soil remediation liability rests on the receiving landowner ($3,864,000), leaving the utility a retained expected liability of $336,000 and a net defection surplus of +$17,914,000/yr, which strictly dominates the compliant hazardous-disposal baseline ($0.0).

Vector3RegulatoryThresholdGapAndFIFRAPre.description: EQ_03: Under 40 C.F.R. 141.61(c), the EPA drinking-water MCL for atrazine (3.0 ppb) sits R_MCL = 3.0 / 0.1 = 30.0x above the 0.1 ppb vertebrate gonadal demasculinization threshold established in Hayes et al., PNAS 99(8):5476-5480 (2002) and PNAS 107(10):4612-4617 (2010) (10.0% complete genetic-male-to-fertile-female conversion), while FIFRA 7 U.S.C. 136v(b) preempts state failure-to-warn tort claims whenever the EPA-registered label is maintained.

fifra_preemption_scope.const: State failure-to-warn tort claims are preempted to the extent they impose labeling or packaging requirements in addition to or different from the EPA-registered label (Bates v. Dow Agrosciences LLC, 544 U.S. 431 (2005)).
